name: 78L12
description: Positive-rail 12V fixed linear regulator, 100mA, in TO-92. The low-power member of the 78xx family for 12V, needing no external components. TO-92 pin order is VOUT(1)/GND(2)/VIN(3) (front view, flat face toward you).

pins.name: VOUT
pins.description: regulated +12V output (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: VOUT, GND, VIN left to right (datasheet numbering matches this front view).

typical_application: Local on-card +12V regulation for low-current analog/logic from an unregulated 15-27V rail, with no external parts required.
gotchas: TO-92 order OUT/GND/IN is the REVERSE of the negative 79Lxx (GND/IN/OUT); the two families do not share a footprint orientation
this TO-92 OUT/GND/IN order is also opposite the big 7812 TO-220 (IN/GND/OUT, tab=GND); do not carry the TO-220 pinout over
only 100mA; for higher current use the 7812 in TO-220
